sv.title: Bilist krockade in i varningsbil på E6 – "Har nog varit en rejäl smäll"
sv.summary: En personbil har kört in i en TMA-bil på E6 söder om Håslöv, i norrgående riktning.

en.title: Motorist crashes into warning vehicle on E6 – "Must have been a real bang"
en.summary: A passenger car has driven into a TMA vehicle on the E6 south of Håslöv, in the northbound direction.
